prereg.written: before any v10 eval ran; eval_v10.py loads this file rather than restating its constants
prereg.claim_available: NON-INFERIORITY on the two frozen instruments (label noise forbids reading small AUC differences on the >=3 boundary, protocol §3); SEPARATION-vs-chance on the new instrument, whose bar is derived from its own power below.
prereg.baseline: v8 RE-SCORED on the v10 tiles, not v8's own numbers from eval_results_v8.json. v8's flat-8000 cache was deleted 2026-07-31, and the deployed system today renders through the live auto_maxiter policy anyway — so v8-on-v10-tiles IS the deployed system, and it is what a deploy decision must be made against.

instrument_check.why_the_check_inverts: v9's intervention was the render path, so identical eval tiles meant a blind instrument. v10's intervention is the data, so identical eval tiles are CORRECT — what must move is the model. The failure mode to guard instead is an eval slice that cannot see the population the new labels come from, which is why the uniform-90 exists.
instrument_check.expected: census-144 and floor-526: 100% identical to v9's tiles. uniform-90: 100% new, because those locations did not exist in v9. Anything else means the recipe moved and the whole battery is measuring that instead.
instrument_check.what_the_frozen_arms_cannot_see: every appended location is a NATIVE-plane maneuver view (mandelbrot / multibrot3/4/5); the census is julia:multibrot only. A null on the census is therefore the EXPECTED outcome and reads as non-regression, not as a null result about the appended data.

primary_census144.metric: AUC(label>=3 vs rest), paired DeLong, v10 vs v8 on the same tiles
primary_census144.bar: NON-INFERIOR iff AUC_v10 >= AUC_v8_rescored - 0.05 AND the paired DeLong does not put v10 significantly below v8 (p < 0.05 AND delta < 0)
primary_census144.style: identical construction to the v8-vs-v7 and v9-vs-v8 primaries

floor_loose0_v3.metric: AUC(label>=3 vs rest), paired DeLong, v10 vs v8 on the same tiles
floor_loose0_v3.bar: NON-INFERIOR iff AUC_v10 >= AUC_v8_rescored - 0.05 AND the paired DeLong does not put v10 significantly below v8 (p < 0.05 AND delta < 0)
floor_loose0_v3.note: SYMMETRIC: v8 and v10 both trained on these locations, so neither arm is flattered.

new_uniform90.instrument: maneuver_uniform_v1, 90 locations — the only score-unconditioned draw over the maneuver-view population
new_uniform90.metric: AUC(label>=2 vs rest); AUC + bootstrap CI reported for BOTH models, plus paired DeLong
new_uniform90.boundary_choice: >=2, not >=3: the leg came back 0/90 at the >=3 emission floor, so a >=3 read has zero positives and no power at all. >=2 has 22 positives, which is the only boundary on this population with any power.
new_uniform90.bar: SEPARATES iff AUC_v10 >= 0.64 AND the 95% bootstrap CI's lower bound > 0.50. Below that the arm is UNDERPOWERED, which per protocol §3 means 'label more', NOT 'the model failed'.
new_uniform90.gating_note: NOT gating for adoption — it is a 90-row arm and this is its first run, so it has no prior version to be non-inferior to. It is the reason the retrain exists and is reported at equal prominence; a future v11 can make it gating once a v10 number exists to beat.
new_uniform90.v8_baseline_expectation: v8 is measured non-separating on this population. That flat result is the number to beat, and it is COMPUTED here rather than assumed — v8's AUC and CI on these same 90 tiles are reported.

class4_descriptive.metric: AUC(label==4 vs rest), reported for v10 and v8
class4_descriptive.note: DESCRIPTIVE, no bar. The 23 appended class-4 locations are ALL train-side and must not appear in any eval number; eval_v10.py asserts the eval slice holds exactly 22 class-4 rows, all census.

prereg.label_noise_discipline: No small-AUC-difference reads on the >=3 boundary. Only the bars above are verdicts; every other number in the battery is descriptive and is labeled so.
prereg.adoption: THIS PROMPT DOES NOT ADOPT. ACTIVE_CKPT stays v8 and no threshold file is touched. Adoption is a separate prompt judged against these bars.

arms.baseline: v8 re-scored on the v10 tiles — THE DEPLOYED SYSTEM
arms.note: inputs are held identical between arms by construction, so no diagnostic arm is needed: the only thing that differs is the model.
